evidence: Fixes bitcoin-cli -ipcconnect error reporting when calls are denied by whitelist and adds IPC CLI test coverage in test/functional/interface_ipc_cli.py.
rationale: Resolves confusing JSON type errors when refused RPC calls are transmitted across IPC. The description notes that because bitcoin-cli -ipcconnect receives only the response body without HTTP headers, empty HTTP 403 replies triggered type errors rather than permission errors, as identified in a private security review.
